items.title: OpenAI 推出 Agents API
items.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Agents API 公测版，一次调用即可构建生产级云端智能体
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Public Beta Agents API for Production Cloud Agents
items.summary: OpenAI launched a public beta Agents API that lets developers create production cloud agents via a single API call using an open-source Codex harness.

items.title: A misalignment of AI in mathematics
items.title_zh: 陶哲轩等数学家批评 OpenAI 在数学领域的方法
items.title_en: Terry Tao and Mathematicians Criticize OpenAI's Methods in Mathematics
items.summary: Terry Tao and other top mathematicians critique OpenAI's methods in mathematics, sparking a high-engagement Hacker News discussion on AI's impact on mathematical research, credit, and understanding.

items.title: I spent $220 on Google app ads and 60% of the installs were robots
items.title_zh: 开发者发现 220 美元谷歌广告带来的安装中 60% 是机器人
items.title_en: Developer finds 60% of $220 Google ad installs were bots
items.summary: A developer documents spending $220 on Google app-install ads only to find 60% of installs came from bot farms, sparking a Hacker News discussion on ad fraud detection and mitigation.

items.title: Any Nix package, live in your browser
items.title_zh: trynix.dev 在浏览器中启动过去 13 年的任意 Nix 软件包
items.title_en: trynix.dev boots any Nix package from 13 years in a browser
items.summary: trynix.dev lets you boot an x86_64 Linux VM entirely in the browser via qemu-wasm and run any of the last 13 years of Nix packages through a URL-addressable interactive shell.

items.title: Nvidia’s Backstop Universe – Heads I Win, Tails Who Loses?
items.title_zh: SemiAnalysis 质疑 Nvidia AI 兜底交易中风险由谁承担
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis Questions Who Bears the Risk in Nvidia's AI Backstop Deals
items.summary: SemiAnalysis examines Nvidia's backstop economics and the limits of its balance sheet amid the $11T AI infrastructure buildout, questioning who ultimately bears the risk.

items.title: Training a 210M text-to-image DiT from scratch on one GPU: what I measured [P]
items.title_zh: 工程师在单块 GPU 上从零训练 210M 参数文生图 DiT
items.title_en: Engineer trains 210M text-to-image DiT from scratch on a single GPU
items.summary: A Reddit post shares three novel measurements from training a 210M-parameter text-to-image diffusion transformer from scratch on one GPU, covering attention sinks and loss-quality divergence.

items.title: 🤖 GPT‑Live‑1 登陆 OpenAI API
items.title_zh: OpenAI 在 API 上线全双工语音模型 GPT-Live-1
items.title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-Live-1 full-duplex voice model in the API
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1 on its API, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model with interruption handling, noise robustness, and a reported 30-point gain over GPT-Realtime-2.1 on Full Duplex Bench at $0.05 per minute.

items.title: GitLab 修复 CVSS 10.0 漏洞：自建实例或遭未授权读取服务器文件
items.title_zh: GitLab 修复 CVSS 10.0 漏洞：未授权用户可读取服务器文件
items.title_en: GitLab Patches CVSS 10.0 Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated File Reads
items.summary: GitLab released emergency patches for CVE-2026-85706, a CVSS 10.0 flaw letting unauthenticated users read arbitrary files on self-managed GitLab servers via the commits API.
